newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC MARKET AT RECORD TURNOVER IN SPECIALS.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC MARKET AT RECORD TURNOVER IN SPECIALS.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market saw an all-time turnover record of 57.6 billion lei on Thursday as foreign investors struck special deals in eight stocks, traders said.
The previous session's turnover level was 16.7 billion lei. Volumes also swelled on Thursday, rising to more than 10 million shares from 3.6 million previously.
"The Romanian capital market was under some sort of assault from foreign investors, with both the stock exchange and the OTC market hitting all-time turnover highs," said a trader.

Brokers said the OTC special deals on Thursday involved shares of oil refineries and cement, wire and tyre makers, all bought for low prices. They said some investors were attracted to one hotelier and a chain of retail stores.
Operators said they expected high-caps to touch new lows on Friday as selling pressure built up. "Corrections are necessary, some of the listings are too expensive," said one.
Overall, closing prices of 99 stocks rose on Thursday, while 105 fell and 277 remained flat.

Independent indices VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, slipped 4.1 percent to 3,585.9 points, and BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, went down by 6.07 percent to 2,594.33. Both indicators are based on average prices.

The bourse on Thursday had its own red-letter day, with turnover soaring to an all-time high at 65.5 billion lei. The rise was triggered by specials in first-tier chemical plant Oltchim and Azomures fertiliser maker. But the deals pulled the prices of the two heavyweights lower.

In the OTC system, oil refinery Astra Romana was the most active listing, trading more than 2.4 million shares worth 1.5 billion lei. It had two special trades in 2.3 million shares. Astra inched up 50 lei to close at 930 lei.
Another oil refinery, Arpechim, had three special deals involving 808,600 shares. It lost 3,500 lei to 24,500.
Cement maker Romcim, a top performer for months, closed 1,000 lei weaker at 71,000. Traders said the fall was due to a special deal in 300,000 shares at 60,000 lei per share.
Wire maker Ductil, an attraction in recent weeks, also reported a special deal in one million shares worth 600 million lei. It closed 150 lei firmer at 1,600.
